column1: # One character per sound. Vowels: a e i o u; E = ɛ, O = ɔ, @ = ə/ɨ (reduced), 6 = ɐ, 1 = ɨ (Romanian â/î), y = French u, 2 = ø, 9 = œ; nasal: A = ã/ɑ̃, 3 = ẽ/ɛ̃, I = ĩ, U = ũ, Q = õ/ɔ̃. Consonants as IPA where plain; S = ʃ, Z = ʒ, C = tʃ, 7 = dʒ, 4 = ts, N = ɲ, L = ʎ, T = θ, x = Spanish j, B D G = Spanish soft b d g, r = tap, R = trill or uvular r, h = Brazilian strong r, j w = glides. Doubled letters = Italian long consonants. ES Peninsular Spanish, EP Lisbon Portuguese, BP São Paulo Portuguese. The most common everyday word per variety (BP cachorro, você, fumaça).
